user_prompt: I am a healthy adult with some gym experience. Give me a simple 3-day full body strength training routine.
ai_response:
If you're a healthy adult with some gym experience, a 3-day full-body routine built around compound lifts is an efficient way to gain strength while allowing enough recovery.

Aim for non-consecutive training days (for example, Monday, Wednesday, and Friday). Before each workout, do 5–10 minutes of light cardio and a few warm-up sets of your first lift.

### Day 1

| Exercise | Sets × Reps |
| --- | --- |
| Back squat | 3 × 5 |
| Bench press | 3 × 5 |
| Bent-over barbell row | 3 × 6–8 |
| Romanian deadlift | 2 × 8 |
| Plank | 3 × 30–60 seconds |

### Day 2

| Exercise | Sets × Reps |
| --- | --- |
| Deadlift | 3 × 3–5 |
| Overhead press | 3 × 5 |
| Pull-ups or lat pulldowns | 3 × 6–10 |
| Bulgarian split squat | 2 × 8 per leg |
| Hanging knee raises or cable crunches | 3 × 10–15 |

### Day 3

| Exercise | Sets × Reps |
| --- | --- |
| Front squat or leg press | 3 × 5–8 |
| Incline dumbbell bench press | 3 × 6–8 |
| Seated cable row or chest-supported row | 3 × 8 |
| Dumbbell Romanian deadlift or hip thrust | 2 × 8–10 |
| Farmer's carry | 3 × 20–40 meters |

### Progression

- Start with weights that leave about 1–2 repetitions "in reserve" at the end of each set.
- When you complete all prescribed reps with good technique, increase the weight at the next session:
    - Upper-body lifts: about 2–2.5 kg (5 lb).
    - Lower-body lifts: about 2.5–5 kg (5–10 lb).
- If you miss your target reps for two consecutive workouts, reduce the weight by about 10% and build back up.

### Rest periods

- Main compound lifts: 2–4 minutes between sets.
- Accessory exercises: 60–90 seconds.
- Core exercises: 30–60 seconds.

### General tips

- Prioritize good technique over adding weight.
- Get 7–9 hours of sleep when possible.
- Eat enough protein (around 1.2–2.0 g/kg of body weight per day is a common target for people who strength train).
- If you feel unusually fatigued or sore, it's fine to reduce volume or take an extra recovery day.

This routine should take about **50–70 minutes** per workout and provides balanced training for the major muscle groups while emphasizing strength development.
